definitionEn: understanding and recognition of the real value, quality or importance of something
senseNote: Выбрано значение «понимание ценности, умение ценить», а не базовое «благодарность».
situation: You recognise how good, valuable or serious something really is, often after learning more about it.

examples.text: A year of piano lessons gave me a much deeper [[appreciation]] of classical music.
The investors clearly had little [[appreciation]] of the risks, so the losses came as a shock.
Guided walks can really increase visitors' [[appreciation]] of the city's old buildings.

texts: Travel gave her a fresh [[appreciation]] of home.
The film shows little [[appreciation]] of how complex the war really was.
Wine tasting classes can sharpen your [[appreciation]] of good food.

badCollocation.noteRu: С appreciation не сочетается big: говорят a deep, real или great appreciation of music.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Понимание приходит постепенно, поэтому говорят develop (или gain) an appreciation. Make, do и take с этим существительным не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Living abroad gave her a deeper [[appreciation]] of her own culture.
nuance.explanationRu: Appreciation — понимание ценности чего-то, умение это ценить. Assessment — оценка, вывод проверяющего или эксперта; «глубокая оценка своей культуры» здесь не по смыслу.

reverse.text: The teacher's [[assessment]] of my essay was fair but quite harsh.
reverse.explanationRu: Оценку работы (балл, вывод проверяющего) называют assessment. Appreciation — не «оценка», а понимание ценности чего-то.

fixIt.text: Working in a hospital gave me a real [[estimation]] of what nurses do every day.
fixIt.explanationRu: Понимание и уважение к чужому труду — appreciation. Estimation — расчёт или приблизительная оценка, а не понимание ценности.

wordFormation.text: The trip gave the students a real [[appreciation]] of how hard farmers work.

reply.context: A colleague says: "I used to find opera boring, but after that evening course I actually love it."
options: That makes sense — they probably gave you an appreciation for finishing the course.
That makes sense — knowing the background gives you a real appreciation of the music.
Indeed, one's appreciation of the operatic form is thereby greatly enhanced.
reply.explanationRu: Курс помог понять и полюбить оперу — это appreciation. В первом ответе слово понято как награда за курс, третий звучит как научная статья, а не реплика коллеге.

rewrite.original: Few voters really understand how serious the problem is.
rewrite.frame: Few voters have a real ____ how serious the problem is.
rewrite.explanationRu: Have an appreciation of something — ясно понимать, насколько это важно или серьёзно.

definitionEn: based on chance or personal whim rather than on reason or a clear system
situation: A decision or rule seems to be made without any good reason, often unfairly, just because someone chose it.

examples.text: The new dress code feels completely [[arbitrary]] — nobody can explain why jeans are banned but trainers aren't.
Human rights groups have condemned the [[arbitrary]] arrest of journalists without charge.
The pass mark of 60% is fairly [[arbitrary]]; it could just as easily be 55%.

texts: Some of the club's rules seem totally [[arbitrary]].
Choosing that date was [[arbitrary]]; any Friday would work.
Citizens must be protected from [[arbitrary]] decisions by officials.

badCollocation.noteRu: Случайная встреча — a chance meeting. Arbitrary — не «случайный» вообще, а «ничем не обоснованный»: an arbitrary rule, decision.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Решение без разумных причин — an arbitrary decision. Optional — необязательный, occasional — редкий, accidental — случайный, по ошибке.

nuance.text: The court ruled that his detention without trial had been [[arbitrary]] and unlawful.
nuance.explanationRu: Arbitrary — сделанный по чьему-то произволу, без законных оснований; это типичный юридический термин. Random — случайный, выбранный наугад, и к решению суда о задержании не подходит.

reverse.text: Winners will be chosen by [[random]] selection from all the entries.
reverse.explanationRu: Выбор наугад, как в лотерее, — random selection. Arbitrary selection означало бы выбор по чьей-то прихоти, то есть нечестный.

fixIt.text: Staff complain that bonuses are handed out in a completely [[accidental]] way.
fixIt.explanationRu: Премии раздают без понятных причин — это arbitrary. Accidental значит «случайный, произошедший по ошибке», как accidental damage.

wordFormation.text: Critics attacked the [[arbitrariness]] of the new visa rules.

reply.context: Your friend complains: "My landlord says I can't have guests after 10 p.m., but he never explains why."
options: That sounds completely arbitrary — ask him to show you where it says that in the contract.
That sounds completely arbitrary — at least he explained his reasons so clearly.
Such a regulation would appear to be of an arbitrary nature, one must concede.
reply.explanationRu: Правило без объяснений — arbitrary, первый ответ точен. Во втором противоречие: если причины объяснены, правило не arbitrary. Третий слишком официальный для разговора с другом.

definitionEn: connected with the design, style and construction of buildings
situation: You talk about the style, design or structure of buildings, for example on a city tour.

examples.text: The old railway station is one of the city's finest [[architectural]] treasures.
The competition asks young designers to submit [[architectural]] drawings of a new library.
Critics say the new shopping centre has no [[architectural]] merit whatsoever.

texts: The castle is a true [[architectural]] gem.
Students spend five years on their [[architectural]] training.
The report praises the [[architectural]] quality of the new schools.

badCollocation.noteRu: Архитектурный факультет — the faculty (или school) of architecture. Architectural описывает здания и стиль: architectural style.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Наследие в виде зданий — architectural heritage. Structural — «несущий, конструкционный», constructive — «полезный», architect — существительное.

nuance.text: With its arches and painted ceilings, the palace is one of Europe's great [[architectural]] masterpieces.
nuance.explanationRu: Architectural — про стиль, красоту и замысел здания. Structural — про несущие конструкции и прочность, а арки и росписи хвалят не за прочность.

reverse.text: After the earthquake, engineers found serious [[structural]] damage in the bridge.
reverse.explanationRu: Повреждения несущих конструкций — structural damage. Architectural описывает стиль и дизайн, а не прочность моста.

fixIt.text: The museum won an award for the bold [[architecture]] design of its new wing.
fixIt.explanationRu: Перед design нужно прилагательное: architectural design. Architecture — существительное, «архитектура».

wordFormation.text: The street is lined with houses of great [[architectural]] interest.

definitionEn: a collection of historical records or documents, or the place where they are kept
situation: Historians or journalists search through old letters, photos and official papers stored together in one place.

examples.text: She spent six months in the national [[archives]], reading old letters and official reports.
The newspaper has put its entire [[archive]] of articles since 1900 online.
Historians were thrilled when a lost letter by the composer turned up in a church [[archive]].

texts: The agency's photo [[archive]] is now online.
He found the original contract in the company [[archive]].
Our digital [[archive]] holds every issue since 1985.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Поднять архивы» — не raise, а go through или search the archives.

collocationTask.prompt: rare ___ footage of the city in the 1920s
collocationTask.explanationRu: Старые кадры из архива — archive (или archival) footage. Memory, record и history так с footage не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The film [[archive]] holds more than ten thousand silent movies.
nuance.explanationRu: Archive — целое собрание документов, фильмов или фото (или место, где оно хранится). Record — одна запись или документ о чём-то; тысячи фильмов в record не хранятся.

reverse.text: There is no [[record]] of his arrival in the city.
reverse.explanationRu: Запись или документ о событии — record. Archive — большое собрание таких документов, а не одна запись о приезде.

fixIt.text: The museum's photo [[fund]] contains over a million images from the 1920s.
fixIt.explanationRu: Русское «фонд» (собрание документов или фото) по-английски — archive или collection. Fund — это деньги.

wordFormation.text: The historian based her book on years of careful [[archival]] research.

definitionEn: an area of public life, such as politics, where people compete for power or influence
senseNote: Выбрано переносное значение («политическая арена», «поприще»), а не «крытый стадион».
situation: You describe politics, business or international relations as a place of competition and conflict.

examples.text: After twenty years as a doctor, she decided to enter the political [[arena]].
Small start-ups often struggle to survive in the global business [[arena]].
Social media has turned into a noisy [[arena]] where politicians fight for attention.

texts: She has been active in the political [[arena]] for decades.
The court case moved the debate into the legal [[arena]].
Few women competed in the business [[arena]] back then.

badCollocation.noteRu: По-русски «на арене», но по-английски — in the political arena, с предлогом in.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Начать карьеру в политике — enter the political arena. Area — «район, область», square — площадь, ground — земля; с political так не говорят.

nuance.text: After retiring from football, he moved into the political [[arena]] and ran for mayor.
nuance.explanationRu: Arena — поле борьбы и соперничества: the political arena. Area — «район» или «область знаний» (my area of research); о политике как о борьбе так не говорят.

reverse.text: Her main [[area]] of research is child psychology.
reverse.explanationRu: Область исследований — area of research. Arena — поле борьбы и соперничества, к науке в таком значении не подходит.

fixIt.text: Many actors have stepped into the political [[area]], with mixed results.
fixIt.explanationRu: Политика как поле борьбы — the political arena. Area — «район» или «область»; the political area звучит неестественно.

definitionEn: used when giving an opinion that you believe can be supported with good reasons
situation: You give a strong opinion, often with a superlative, while admitting that other people might disagree.

examples.text: Penicillin was [[arguably]] the most important medical discovery of the twentieth century.
Her second novel is [[arguably]] her best, though some critics still prefer her first.
For a new manager, clear communication is [[arguably]] more important than technical skill.

texts: It is [[arguably]] the best pizza in town.
She was [[arguably]] the greatest tennis player of her era.
This is [[arguably]] the most important decision you'll ever make.

badCollocation.noteRu: Arguably не значит бытовое «может быть»: так говорят о мнении, которое можно обосновать (arguably the best). «Может, приду» — maybe I'll come.

collocationTask.prompt: ___ one of the greatest writers of all time
collocationTask.explanationRu: Arguably ставят перед превосходной степенью: arguably one of the greatest. Accordingly, respectively и consequently — связки «соответственно, следовательно».

nuance.text: It's [[arguably]] the best album of the decade, though some critics prefer her earlier work.
nuance.explanationRu: Arguably — «пожалуй, можно утверждать»: вы высказываете смелое мнение. Admittedly — «надо признать»: вы уступаете собеседнику. Здесь главное мнение, а не уступка.

reverse.text: [[Admittedly]], I haven't read the whole report, but the summary looks convincing.
reverse.explanationRu: Говорящий признаёт слабое место своей позиции — это admittedly. Arguably вводит смелое утверждение, а не признание.

fixIt.text: He is [[controversially]] the greatest goalkeeper the club has ever had.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Пожалуй, величайший» — arguably the greatest. Controversially значит «вызывая споры, скандально» и не смягчает оценку.

reply.context: In a book club chat, someone asks: "Which of her novels should I start with?"
options: Try the second one — it's arguably 300 pages long, so you'll finish it quickly.
Try the second one — it's arguably her best, and it's quite short.
One would arguably be best served by commencing with her second effort.
reply.explanationRu: Arguably смягчает оценку, которую можно обосновать: arguably her best. Число страниц — факт, о нём не спорят. Третий ответ слишком напыщенный для чата.

definitionEn: to give yourself or someone the knowledge, tools or information needed for a challenge
senseNote: Выбрано переносное значение «вооружить знаниями, фактами, инструментами», а не буквальное «вооружать оружием».
situation: Before a difficult meeting or task, you prepare by collecting the facts, skills or tools you will need.

examples.text: Before the salary talks, she [[armed]] herself with data on what competitors pay.
The course [[arms]] students with the practical skills that employers are looking for.
[[Arm]] yourself with a good map before you explore the old town.

texts: She arrived at the meeting [[armed]] with charts and graphs.
Tourists came [[armed]] with cameras and guidebooks.
Parents went to the school [[armed]] with a list of complaints.

badCollocation.noteRu: После arm нужен предлог with: arm yourself with the facts. Русский творительный падеж здесь передаётся через with, а не by.

collocationTask.explanationRu: «Запастись терпением» — arm yourself with patience. Stock up on говорят о продуктах, а fill и load с терпением не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Before facing the board, she [[armed]] herself with every figure she could find.
nuance.explanationRu: Arm yourself with — подготовиться к трудной ситуации, «вооружиться» фактами или аргументами. Supply — поставлять товары и материалы; supply yourself with figures звучит неестественно.

reverse.text: A local farm [[supplies]] the restaurant with fresh vegetables.
reverse.explanationRu: Регулярно поставлять продукты — supply. Arm говорят, когда человека готовят к трудной задаче или борьбе, а не о поставках овощей.

fixIt.text: The queue at the visa office is long, so [[stock]] yourself with patience and a good book.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Запастись терпением» — arm yourself with patience. Stock так не употребляется: говорят stock up on food.

reply.context: A colleague messages: "I've got my salary review with the boss tomorrow. Any tips?"
options: Just arm your boss first and then ask him for a raise.
It would be prudent to arm oneself with pertinent performance metrics.
Arm yourself with numbers — list every project you delivered this year.
reply.explanationRu: Arm yourself with numbers — заранее запастись цифрами и фактами. «Arm your boss» звучит как «выдай начальнику оружие», а второй ответ слишком официальный для чата с коллегой.

rewrite.original: Before the debate, he made sure he had all the relevant statistics.
rewrite.frame: Before the debate, he ____ all the relevant statistics.
rewrite.explanationRu: Arm yourself with something — заранее запастись фактами или инструментами.

definitionEn: a large and often impressive collection or range of different things
senseNote: Выбрано общее значение «большое разнообразие, множество», а не «массив» в программировании.
situation: You describe a large, varied and often impressive range of objects, choices or people.

examples.text: The market sells a dazzling [[array]] of spices from all over the world.
The job requires a wide [[array]] of skills, from coding to public speaking.
The hotel offers an impressive [[array]] of activities, from yoga to wine tasting.

texts: The shop stocks a huge [[array]] of teas.
Doctors now have a wide [[array]] of treatments available.
She faced a bewildering [[array]] of choices after graduation.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Лесной массив» — a large area of forest или woodland. Array — множество разных предметов или вариантов: an array of dishes.

collocationTask.explanationRu: «Широкий выбор» — a wide array (или range) of options. Number сочетается с large, а не wide; amount — с неисчисляемыми; row — ряд в пространстве.

nuance.text: The report identifies a whole [[array]] of problems with the new payment system.
nuance.explanationRu: «Целый ряд проблем» — a whole array (или range) of problems. Row — ряд в пространстве: ряд кресел, домов; о множестве проблем так не говорят.

reverse.text: We sat in the front [[row]] and could see every expression on the actors' faces.
reverse.explanationRu: Ряд кресел в зале — row. Array — разнообразное множество чего-то, а не линия мест в театре.

fixIt.text: The new phone comes with a wide [[spectre]] of useful features.
fixIt.explanationRu: Русское «спектр» здесь — array или range. Spectre — ложный друг, по-английски это «призрак».

reply.context: A friend asks: "How was the food festival on Saturday?"
options: Brilliant — I had an array of soup and then went home.
Brilliant — there was a huge array of street food from about thirty countries.
It was agreeable; an array of comestibles was presented for consumption.
reply.explanationRu: Array — большое разнообразие: a huge array of street food. «An array of soup» бессмысленно — это одна тарелка, а третий ответ звучит слишком книжно для разговора с другом.

definitionEn: to express an idea or feeling clearly and effectively in words
senseNote: Выбрано значение «чётко выразить мысль словами»; есть ещё прилагательное articulate — «красноречивый».
situation: You manage to put complicated thoughts or feelings into clear words so that other people understand them.

examples.text: Many patients find it hard to [[articulate]] exactly what is wrong with them.
In her email, she [[articulated]] the team's concerns calmly and clearly.
A good essay [[articulates]] a clear argument and supports it with evidence.

texts: Children often can't [[articulate]] why they feel upset.
The new CEO needs to [[articulate]] a clear vision for the company.
It took me years to [[articulate]] what I really wanted from life.

badCollocation.noteRu: Articulate — переходный глагол: articulate your concerns, без about.

collocationTask.prompt: ___ a clear vision for the future
collocationTask.explanationRu: Чётко изложить видение — articulate a vision. Pronounce — произносить звуки, а tell и speak с vision не сочетаются.

nuance.text: She finally found the words to [[articulate]] her fears about the move.
nuance.explanationRu: Articulate — выразить мысль или чувство словами. Pronounce — произносить звуки и слова; «произнести свои страхи» по-английски не говорят. Русское «артикулировать» — ложный друг.

fixIt.text: At the meeting, she clearly [[sounded]] what most of us had been thinking for weeks.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Озвучить мысль» — articulate или voice, но не sound. Sound значит «звучать»: it sounds great.

wordFormation.text: The report praised the clear [[articulation]] of the company's goals.

reply.context: After a failed project, your manager asks: "So what do you think went wrong?"
options: It's hard to articulate in one sentence, but mostly we never agreed on the goals.
I articulated the budget twice, but the numbers still didn't add up.
Allow me to articulate, if I may, a most comprehensive account of our failings.
reply.explanationRu: Articulate — чётко сформулировать мысль. Бюджет не articulate, его пересчитывают (check, recalculate). Третий ответ звучит напыщенно для рабочего разговора.

rewrite.original: It's hard for me to put my feelings into words.
rewrite.frame: I find it hard to ____ my feelings.
rewrite.explanationRu: Articulate your feelings — выразить чувства словами.

definitionEn: the soft grey powder left after something burns, or thrown into the air by a volcano
senseNote: Выбрано значение «пепел, зола» (в том числе вулканический пепел и rise from the ashes), а не «ясень».
situation: A fire has gone out or a volcano has erupted, and everything is covered in soft grey powder.

examples.text: Hundreds of flights were cancelled because of a huge cloud of volcanic [[ash]].
Many gardeners mix wood [[ash]] into the soil as a natural fertiliser.
When the fire finally went out, all that was left of the barn was a heap of [[ash]].

texts: The old mill was reduced to [[ashes]] in a single night.
The city rose from the [[ashes]] after the great fire.
She searched through the [[ashes]] for her grandmother's ring.

badCollocation.noteRu: Пепел — неисчисляемое существительное: some ash, a pile of ash. An ash — это ясень.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Устойчивое выражение — reduced to ashes, «обращён в пепел». Made, brought и cut в нём не используются.

nuance.text: Grandad tapped his pipe, and a little [[ash]] fell onto the carpet.
nuance.explanationRu: Ash — то, что остаётся после горения: пепел из трубки, зола в печи. Dust — пыль, которая сама оседает на полках; из трубки она не сыплется.

reverse.text: The books on the top shelf were covered in [[dust]].
reverse.explanationRu: Пыль на полках — dust. Ash — пепел или зола после горения; книги покрываются им только после пожара.

fixIt.text: Wait until the stove is cold, then shovel the [[dust]] into a metal bucket.
fixIt.explanationRu: То, что остаётся в печи после горения, — ash (зола). Dust — это пыль, огонь её не оставляет.

wordFormation.text: His face went [[ashen]] when he read the letter.
